themes_detail.label: Street noise explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints spiked to 32 THIS WEEK—a 412% jump from the 8-week average of 6.2 per week (z-score: 10.35)—suggesting a sudden, acute noise source or enforcement gap in Forest Hills/Rego Park.
evidence: 32 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs 6.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
412% increase with z-score of 10.35 (statistically extreme deviation)
Vehicle noise also up 117% THIS WEEK (16 complaints vs 7.4 avg), suggesting concentrated traffic or construction problem
reporting_angles: What new construction, event, or traffic pattern triggered this sudden spike? Interview residents on specific blocks.
Are NYPD or DOT aware? Check enforcement response and any pending street permits.

themes_detail.label: Dead animal spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints reached 8 THIS WEEK—a 611% surge from the 8-week baseline of 1.1 per week (z-score: 8.81)—indicating a potential public health or wildlife issue requiring urgent investigation.
evidence: 8 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
611% increase with z-score of 8.81 (extreme outlier event)
Concurrent rodent spike (14 complaints last week vs 4.2 avg) suggests broader pest/sanitation problem
reporting_angles: Is there a disease outbreak, contaminated food source, or environmental hazard killing animals in the district?
Interview DSNY and NYC Health about cleanup response and root cause investigation.

themes_detail.label: Rodent complaints surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints reached 14 LAST WEEK—a 229% increase from the 8-week average of 4.2 per week (z-score: 4.76)—coinciding with the dead animal spike and suggesting a localized infestation or sanitation failure.
evidence: 14 rodent complaints LAST WEEK vs 4.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Dead animal spike (8 complaints THIS WEEK) overlaps temporally, suggesting ecosystem stress or contamination
reporting_angles: Are DSNY and Health Department investigating a specific block or sanitation violation?
Interview affected residents about sightings; check for recent changes in trash collection or building maintenance.

themes_detail.label: Vehicle noise uptick
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints jumped to 16 THIS WEEK—a 117% increase from the 8-week average of 7.4 per week (z-score: 2.76)—likely tied to the broader street noise spike or new traffic pattern.
evidence: 16 vehicle noise complaints THIS WEEK vs 7.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Part of larger noise cluster (street/sidewalk noise also at 412% spike THIS WEEK)
reporting_angles: Is illegal street racing, commercial delivery traffic, or a broken traffic signal causing the spike?
Check DOT data for recent signal outages or road work on major corridors (Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills Road).

themes_detail.label: Overgrown trees and branches
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree/branch complaints reached 5 THIS WEEK—a 400% surge from the 8-week average of 1.0 per week (z-score: 3.58)—suggesting maintenance backlog or seasonal weather stress affecting street-level conditions.
evidence: 5 overgrown tree complaints THIS WEEK vs 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Aligns with community board's recurring budget request for park/amenity improvements
reporting_angles: Is Parks Department behind on seasonal tree maintenance or facing staffing gaps?
Check if recent weather (wind, rain) caused damage that is now blocking streets or sidewalks.
